verses.en: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
verses.pt: Diz o néscio no seu coração: Não há Deus. Os homens têm-se corrompido, fazem-se abomináveis em suas obras; não há quem faça o bem.
verses.en_web: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. Of David.> The foolish man has said in his heart, God will not do anything. They are unclean, they have done evil works; there is not one who does good.

verses.en: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.
verses.pt: O Senhor olhou do céu para os filhos dos homens, para ver se havia algum que tivesse entendimento, que buscasse a Deus.
verses.en_web: Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord was looking down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who had wisdom, searching after God.

verses.en: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.pt: Desviaram-se todos e juntamente se fizeram imundos; não há quem faça o bem, não há sequer um.
verses.en_web: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
verses.en_bbe: They have all gone out of the way together; they are unclean, there is not one who does good, no, not one.

verses.en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
verses.pt: Acaso não tem conhecimento nem sequer um dos que praticam a iniqüidade, que comem o meu povo como se comessem pão, e que não invocam o Senhor?
verses.en_web: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?
verses.en_bbe: Have all the workers of evil no knowledge? they take my people for food as they would take bread; they make no prayer to the Lord.

verses.en: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.pt: Achar-se-ão ali em grande pavor, porque Deus está na geração dos justos.
verses.en_web: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.en_bbe: Then were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the upright.

verses.en: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
verses.pt: Vós quereis frustar o conselho dos pobres, mas o Senhor é o seu refúgio.
verses.en_web: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because Yahweh is his refuge.
verses.en_bbe: You have put to shame the thoughts of the poor, but the Lord is his support.

verses.en: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.pt: Oxalá que de Sião viesse a salvação de Israel! Quando o Senhor fizer voltar os cativos do seu povo, então se regozijará Jacó e se alegrará Israel.
verses.en_web: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.en_bbe: May the salvation of Israel come out of Zion! when the fate of his people is changed by the Lord, Jacob will have joy and Israel will be glad.
